purpose: Replace blended blink inbetweens with opaque half-closed eyelid key poses

Edit this exact original widescreen illustration. Change ONLY the blonde Sheddy mascot's visible eye(s) to the HALFWAY-CLOSED position of one natural blink. Her upper eyelids have lowered halfway down over the irises, leaving the lower half of the golden iris visible below a single crisp brown upper eyelid/lash line. Do not blend open and closed eyes, no transparent ghosted iris or double eyelid lines.
Keep EXACT same face position, head tilt, eye corner positions, brow shape and mouth expression. Preserve every pixel outside the immediate eyelid/iris area as closely as possible: identical hair, lemon clip, skin shade, clothing, body pose, hands, props, composition, background, light and painting style. In particular do not move the head, redraw the mouth or modify the hair.
